summary: Build battery sizing, safety, and commissioning skills in 5 days. Learn practical methods for credible storage project decisions.
lede: Renewable energy storage training covers how to size and evaluate battery systems against operating requirements. It is for professionals who evaluate, design, specify, commission, or manage battery projects, with practice in calculating capacity and duration, selecting battery and power-conversion approaches, and reviewing protection, commissioning, and performance-monitoring plans.
audienceIntro: This course is intended for professionals who evaluate, design, specify, commission, or manage battery storage projects and need credible engineering outputs.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals, basic power systems concepts, and familiarity with renewable energy project workflows. You should be comfortable reading specifications, nameplate data, and single-line diagrams; no programming is required. If you already work with inverter-based resources, microgrids, or utility interconnection studies, you will be able to apply the content faster. Participants should bring a laptop for calculation exercises and design worksheets.
